system.description:
Built on Project FU's Weaponmaster.

FREE BENEFITS
  • increased maximum Hit Points
  • martial melee proficiency
  • martial shields proficiency

(Printed FREE BENEFITS, listed for reference — inert under the no-innate-benefits rule. Benefits come from the creation benefit-pick pool; see rippers-guise. Adopted from Project FU's Weaponmaster counterpart.)

PRIZEFIGHTER SKILLS

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000191]{Bladestorm} 【Max SL 1】

On a melee attack, spend 10 MP: the attack gains multi (2), or its multi rises by one (max 3).

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000192]{Bone Crusher} 【Max SL 4】

On a damaging melee hit, trade all its damage for one option: dazed on each target; weak on each target; or each target loses (SL × 10) MP.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000193]{Breach} 【Max SL 3】

Action + 10 MP: free single-target melee attack. On a hit choose: +(SL × 5) damage ignoring Resistances but also non-physical Vulnerabilities; or no damage, and your allies deal +(SL × 2) to the target until your next turn.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000194]{Counterattack} 【Max SL 1】

After an enemy's melee attack hits or misses you with an even Accuracy Result: free melee attack back at them alone, High Roll treated as 0.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000195]{Melee Weapon Mastery} 【Max SL 4】

+(SL) to all Accuracy Checks with melee weapons.

@UUID[Compendium.rippers-compendium.skills.Item.RCsk000000000196]{Oathbound} 【Max SL 5】

On finishing a rest, swear to protect someone you hold admiration, loyalty or affection toward: that Bond counts 1 stronger until your next rest, and they may transfer up to (SL × 5) of any HP/MP loss to you.
